newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Oriental Bank to cut prime rate.
newsitem.headline: India's Oriental Bank to cut prime rate.

text.p: India's Oriental Bank of Commerce has decided to cut its prime lending rate to 15.0 percent a year from 15.5 percent with effect from February 1, a senior bank official told Reuters on Tuesday.
"It is purely based on our own working," the official said, referring to augmentation of the bank's lendable resources.
"Of course, the overall trend of credit offtake is also low," the official said. But this was not the main reason for the cut in prime lending rate, he said.
Oriental Bank is one of the few actively traded banking shares on Indian stock exchanges.
